ee83e8e1e26af1b5a99f8971514442501806fc70.summary: F-Secure's report on the Havex RAT. Three industrial software vendor sites in Germany, Switzerland and Belgium were compromised and their installers trojanized. Victims were mostly in Europe, including industrial, educational and construction organisations, and one in California. The report says the operators conduct industrial espionage, gathering details of ICS/SCADA hardware on infected networks, and that no control payloads had been seen so far.

ee5996779b3952cb5225fae31594301f69206383.summary: WIRED article (published 2020-10-19) on a US Department of Justice indictment that names and charges six men for allegedly carrying out costly cyberattacks by Sandworm, described as Russia's most destructive cyberwar unit. The article lists Sandworm attacks: a first-ever cyberattack causing a blackout in Western Ukraine (about half a decade before 2020), a 2016 blackout attack on Kyiv, the 2017 NotPetya worm that spread globally and caused about $10 billion in damage, and a 2018 attack that temporarily destroyed the IT backend of the Winter Olympics in South Korea.

eeda2cd0c11937ecdaf26d2801aa9dd7a706f623.summary: Technical analysis of Alien, an Android banking trojan sold as malware-as-a-service. It was first introduced on MaaS forums by a user named ring0, and the report says it appears to be an extension of Cerberus V1. The report says Alien can send SMS, contacts and call logs to a remote server, run commands from a C2 server, and read incoming notifications. Dates given: Alien released in February 2020, Cerberus development discontinued in early 2020, and Cerberus added Google Authenticator theft in May 2020.

eedc2668633b73cc14f81eaea5fedbecf9f4de6b.summary: VMware's Threat Analysis Unit reports that Winnti 4.0 malware, a modular remote access trojan, is still in use by Chinese threat actors such as APT41. Over two years it found 43 C2 servers (34 unique IPs) and released their indicators of compromise. Hosts may have been reappropriated for legitimate use, so results should be verified before acting.

ee7f161407af863c89f3e5cc6f4ce52266155d7c.summary: This page is a vendor detection rule from Splunk, not a threat report. It describes a search that flags renamed copies of the PsExec remote-execution tool on endpoints, using EDR telemetry. It covers data sources, default schedule, false-positive notes and a list of related analytic stories. It reports no specific actor, campaign, incident or vulnerability.

eeba7b963e4002b7f15df2dd6c4cef6df6d9f9e1.summary: Microsoft Threat Intelligence describes active exploitation of on-premises SharePoint servers through CVE-2025-49706 and CVE-2025-49704, plus follow-on CVE-2025-53770 and CVE-2025-53771. Chinese state actors Linen Typhoon and Violet Typhoon exploit these flaws, and Storm-2603, assessed with moderate confidence as China-based, has used them to deploy Warlock ransomware. Attacks used a web shell to steal MachineKey data, then Mimikatz, PsExec and Impacket for credential theft and lateral movement. Microsoft's guidance is to apply the security updates, enable AMSI, rotate ASP.NET machine keys,…

ee014dd867eed637d08c84509af57fe141d58c21.summary: Sekoia TDR report on ClickFake Interview, a campaign assessed as a continuation of Contagious Interview and attributed to Lazarus (DPRK). Fake job-interview sites lure crypto job seekers into a fake camera-driver error that leads them to run a command. Windows and macOS hosts get the GolangGhost Go backdoor; macOS also gets FrostyFerret, a password stealer. Lures target crypto finance firms and non-developer roles. The report counts 184 invitations and 14 lure companies. It cites Bybit's $1.5 billion theft in March 2025 as background.
